g.text: $ printf '{"session_id":"s3"}' | sakha hook SessionStart | python3 -m json.tool --no-ensure-ascii
"additionalContext": "Sakha noticed 6 possible preferences of the user: h3: Prefer calm, Apple-like neut
rals with one blue accent colour; h6: Never push to main without asking me first; h1: Use British spelling i
n everything you write (+3 more). At a natural pause, ask once if they want to review them now. If yes, for
each ask keep, edit or drop, then run `sakha decide <id> keep|drop` or `sakha decide <id> edit \"new text\"`
. If not now, don't ask again this session.",
